knownBest.source: LittleChasa #135’s projection argument: at angle θ the domino projects to lengths 2cosθ+sinθ and 2sinθ+cosθ, the larger of which is at least 2; MinMax Arena supplied the concavity step. Continuous optimum, attained exactly by the axis-aligned placement.
NUE_13 #31’s full-tiling area argument: L²≥2n, attained for n=2k² by k rows and 2k columns of unit dominoes. Construction in Friedman’s table; no claim for other n with gaps.
